summary: Storefront reuse map for native WeChat miniprogram: cookie-session API client under `/api/v1`, minimalist design tokens (ink/coral/canvas + 2px radius), 14 Vue routes mapped to core miniprogram pages, port-worthy helpers (money/status/SKU/address/capabilities), and Vue/Vite deps that must NOT be brought over.

files.detail: Mirror: api<T>(path, init?, options?), ApiError, ApiEnvelope, credentials include, /api/v1 prefix, 401→login, money(fen), dateTime, fileSize, safeRedirect, redirectToLogin

Global design tokens + minimalist UI shell

fallbackTokens + TemplateTokens + parseTemplate/applyTemplateTheme; defaults primary/ink #111111, accent #E4644F, canvas #F7F6F3, surface #FFFFFF, muted #8A8781, radius 2px, headingFont serif

SKU selection + qty + add-to-cart business UI

loadStorefront, loadProducts, loadCart, setCart(skuId, quantity, selected); getters selectedItems, cartCount
Product, ProductSku, ProductDetail, Category, Cart-facing fields, OrderDetail, AfterSale, StorefrontTemplate

files.detail: productPrice(product): min===max ? money(min) : `${money(min)} 起`; category/scene/search filters
POST /orders with clientRequestId, source H5|WEB, address, items[{skuId,quantity}]; total = Σ priceFen*qty
POST /auth/dev-login, POST /auth/wechat/authorize, GET /system/capabilities; inviteCode vs sponsorClaimSecret mutual exclusion

facts: API base: fetch(`/api/v1${path}`) with credentials:'include' — cookie/session auth, no Authorization header, no localStorage token
ApiEnvelope<T>={success,code,message,data}; throws ApiError(message,status,code) on network/invalid/!ok/!success
401 handling: redirectToLogin('session-expired') unless options.redirectOnUnauthorized===false
Dev proxy (vite.config.ts): '/api' → 'http://127.0.0.1:8080'
money(fen)=Intl.NumberFormat('zh-CN',{style:'currency',currency:'CNY'}).format(fen/100)
dateTime(value?)=value?new Date(value).toLocaleString('zh-CN'):'—'
fileSize(bytes): B / KB / MB thresholds at 1024 and 1024^2
session: loadUserSession → GET /auth/me; requireUserSession used by router beforeEach for meta.requiresAuth

CSS tokens (:root styles.css): --ink #111111, --ink-soft #2A2A2A, --muted #8A8781, --paper #FFFFFF, --canvas #F7F6F3, --line #E5E2DC, --line-strong #D4D0C8, --coral #E4644F, --coral-dark #C74F3B, --gold #A07A3A, --green #245F4E, --green-dark #1A463A, --sage #E8EDE8, --shadow-sm none, --shadow-lg none
Theme aliases: --theme-primary=var(--ink), --theme-accent=var(--coral), --theme-canvas, --theme-surface, --theme-ink, --theme-muted, --theme-radius:2px, --theme-heading=var(--font-display)
Typography: body Inter/SF Pro/PingFang/YaHei; --font-display Noto Serif SC / Source Han Serif / Songti
template.ts fallbackTokens (minimalist redesign defaults): primary #111111, accent #E4644F, canvas #F7F6F3, surface #FFFFFF, ink #111111, muted #8A8781, radius 2px, headingFont 'serif'
MINIMAL preset CSS: topbar height 68px, brand-mark square outline transparent, primary inherits theme

Router routes (main.ts): / HomeView; /login LoginView; /products/:id ProductView; /content/:id ContentDetailView; /cart CartView auth; /checkout CheckoutView auth; /orders OrdersView auth; /orders/:id OrderDetailView auth; /membership MembershipView auth; /addresses AddressesView auth; /after-sales AfterSalesView auth; /after-sales/:id AfterSaleDetailView auth; /notifications NotificationsView auth; /rules RulesView

Core miniprogram 1:1 map: home=/; category=home CATEGORY_NAV (no standalone category route); goods detail=/products/:id; cart=/cart; checkout=/checkout; orders=/orders + /orders/:id; addresses=/addresses; login=/login
Extra pages not in core list: membership, after-sales(+detail), notifications, rules, content/:id

SKU logic (ProductView.vue): default selectedSkuId = first inventory>0 else skus[0]; selectSku resets qty=1; maxQuantity=min(99,inventory); attributeSummary parses attributesJson object values join ' · '
productPrice (StorefrontRenderer.vue): minPriceFen===maxPriceFen ? money(min) : `${money(min)} 起`
Cart total: selectedItems.reduce((s,i)=>s+i.priceFen*i.quantity,0)

statusText keys: PENDING_SUPERIOR, SUPERIOR_REJECTED, PENDING_ADMIN_REVIEW, ADMIN_REJECTED, PENDING_SHIPMENT, SHIPPED, COMPLETED, CANCELLED, AWAITING_RETURN, RETURN_SHIPPED, PENDING_OFFLINE_REFUND, PENDING_BUYER_REFUND_CONFIRMATION, REJECTED
orderStatusLabel(status)=statusText[status]??'未知订单状态'
resolveOrderActions: canReceive/canUploadProof/canCancel/canSuperiorDecide only true if ===true
address helpers: parseAddress JSON→Address or {address:raw}; addressLines → name·phone, region+detail, 邮编

Key API paths: /auth/me, /auth/dev-login, /auth/wechat/authorize, /system/capabilities, /catalog/products, /catalog/products/:id, /catalog/categories, /storefront/template, /content, /content/:id, /cart, /cart/items/:skuId PUT, /addresses, /orders, /orders/:id, /orders/:id/receive, /orders/:id/cancel, /orders/:id/proofs, /superior/orders, /superior/orders/:id/decision, /after-sales*, /membership/*, /notifications*, /rules/active
package.json scripts: dev=vite --host 0.0.0.0 --port 5173; build=vue-tsc -b && vite build; typecheck=vue-tsc -b; test=node --test tests/*.test.mjs
dependencies (DO NOT port): vue ^3.5.22, vue-router ^4.6.3, pinia ^3.0.3, dompurify ^3.4.12, qrcode ^1.5.4
devDependencies (DO NOT port): vite ^7.1.9, @vitejs/plugin-vue ^6.0.1, typescript ^5.9.3, vue-tsc ^3.1.1, @types/node, @types/qrcode
Miniprogram utils/request.js should mirror: baseURL + /api/v1, cookie/session or wx.login token adapter, envelope unwrap, ApiError shape, 401 re-login, money/dateTime helpers
risks: Auth is HTTP cookie via credentials:'include' — native miniprogram cannot reuse browser cookies; need wx.login / custom token header adapter while keeping same envelope + path contract
No standalone /category route — category is a home section filter; miniprogram may still want pages/category/index for UX parity
DOMPurify/sanitizeRichText is browser-only; product descriptionHtml needs different sanitization or rich-text component strategy on miniprogram
WeChat H5/WEB authorize redirect flow in LoginView is not miniprogram login; miniprogram should use code2session-style backend path if available
Checkout source field is 'H5'|'WEB' from viewport width — miniprogram should send a distinct source if backend accepts it
qrcode package is for membership invitation QR on web; miniprogram should use native canvas/QR components instead
